headline: Executive order creates a federal advisory board on toxic substances and worker health.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new advisory board that focuses on toxic substances and the health of workers. Based on the title alone, the board's role is to give advice to the federal government rather than to make binding rules. The title does not give details on the board's members, duties, or which programs it advises on.

who_it_affects.group: Workers exposed to toxic substances on the job
who_it_affects.how: The board is meant to give the government advice on issues tied to their health and toxic exposures.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle worker health issues
who_it_affects.how: They would receive advice from the new board.
